text:
incident-bot: Pager: automated alert — Elevated 5xx rate observed across hosted API (/v1/generate, /v1/chat). Error rate ~14% (x6 baseline). Primary symptom: control-plane deps failing (auth / org-lookup / billing throttles). Paging on-call: frank-sre.

frank-sre: ack. I'm looking. Starting Triage.

frank-sre: quick snapshot from gateway logs pasted below
```
gateway: upstream auth-proxy 502, org-lookup 504, billing 429 -> increased 5xx/timeout mix
sample: 2026-03-15T09:44:52Z GET /v1/generate 502 auth-proxy timeout
5xx_rate: 14.2% (5m rolling)
```

gina-eng-runtime: seeing same in runtime metrics — token generation failing intermittently when calling auth service. KV cache miss rate up, retries stacking.

alice: product impact? any customers reporting errors yet?

eve-support: yep support queue has ~18 tickets referencing 502/503 in last 20m. Affected customers: org-A, org-C, handful of smaller PLG signups. Sent initial template to customers asking them to retry.

ben: can we isolate whether this is a recent deploy? config-rollouts?

frank-sre: checking deploys — no code deploys to auth-proxy in last 2 hours. There was a config rollout to auth-proxy (circuit config) 30m ago though. Rolling that back now to confirm.

frank-sre: rollback command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/auth-proxy -n controlplane`

carol: I'm on org-lookup service — seeing thread pool exhaustion and consistent 500s from downstream DB reads. Root cause looks like sudden traffic pattern hitting path /org/lookup with long tail queries.

dave: billing team reports rate limiter tripping on their side and returning 429s. That's cascading back into our gateway as errors.

frank-sre: mitigation plan (short list):
1) rollback auth-proxy config (done)
2) scale auth-proxy + org-lookup replicas up `kubectl scale deployment auth-proxy --replicas=6` and `kubectl scale deployment org-lookup --replicas=5`
3) enable short-term circuit-break on auth calls from runtime (fail-fast)
4) enable prefix caching for org lookups for 60s TTL
5) ask billing to relax rate limits for our control plane origin while we stabilize

gina-eng-runtime: applied runtime circuit-break policy (fail fast after 2 retries, 200ms), enabled in Canary. Pushing full rollout in 2m if metrics look good.

frank-sre: scaled auth-proxy + org-lookup and opened extra pods. Command run: `kubectl scale deployment auth-proxy -n controlplane --replicas=6`

carol: org-lookup DB queries optimized for hot keys, applied query timeout of 300ms to avoid blocking. Cache is warming; cache hit rate moving 0% -> 62% over 4 minutes.

ben: billing agreed to temporary higher rate limit for our infra origin ID: billing-team assigned a lift for 15m.

eve-support: updated customers via status page (minor partial outage): https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/315900 — queued support followups.

frank-sre: immediate impact metric: 5xx rate down from 14% -> 4.8% after scale + circuit-break + cache. Latency for /v1/generate down to 420ms p50. Still above normal but improving.

gina-eng-runtime: merging circuit-break rollout to 100% now. Observability: adding trace to requests failing auth to capture headers.

carol: org-lookup error budget for this hour burned. We'll keep cache TTL at 60s for next 2 hours.

dave: billing team still seeing a small surge — they will keep the temporary limit and monitor.

alice: do we need to page oncall for dedicated customers or sales? I'd like PRD notified if top-customer A still failing.

frank-sre: agree. @alice, please coordinate with GTM. @eve-support can you prepare messaging for top customers? Keep it factual: degraded control-plane dependencies causing intermittent 5xx for some API calls, mitigation in progress.

eve-support: on it. Draft message ready, will send once we confirm <5% 5xx sustained for 10m.

frank-sre: next steps: continue monitoring for 30m, keep cache TTL and circuit-break active, verify no config rollouts target control plane for 1h. If 5xx >8% again, we'll initiate failover to alternate auth instance in secondary region.

gina-eng-runtime: alert rule adjusted: raise threshold to 6% for a separate page to infra-oncall so noise reduced. Added a dashboard link: https://observability.redwood.ai/dashboards/315900

carol: deploying a small hotfix to org-lookup query planner to avoid full table scans for some malformed requests. Canary 1/3 pods green.

frank-sre: handoff plan: I'll stay on for next 20m then hand to gina for monitoring and follow-up. If anything regresses, escalate to eng-sre lead.

gina-eng-runtime: ack. I'll take over at +20m and coordinate with billing if we need longer rate-limit lifts.

frank-sre: final note — incident severity: P2 (partial degradation) for hosted API. Rough customer impact: approx 8% of requests from 3% of tenants experiencing errors. Creating incident ticket: INC-315900 in ops tracker.

eve-support: support is triaging open tickets and replying with status id INC-315900. Templates sent to affected customers.

frank-sre: thanks team. I'll post a retrospective summary after stabilization. :thumbsup:
